nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (Root)
nodes.rationale: Root project guidance file providing overview, commands, architecture highlights, known issues, and workflow for the ZapTI monorepo

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Four workspace structure: apps/api, apps/web, packages/shared, packages/database

nodes.label: apps/api (Fastify API)
nodes.rationale: Fastify + Prisma + TypeScript API server on port 3000 with plugins, routes, services, JWT auth, multi-tenant

nodes.label: apps/web (Next.js Web)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 + React 18 + Tailwind frontend on port 3001 with Radix UI, TanStack Query, Zustand

nodes.label: packages/shared
nodes.rationale: ESM shared package with config, auth, email, notification, utils, constants, validation, types exports

nodes.label: packages/database
nodes.rationale: Prisma schema & migrations package - single source of truth for data model

nodes.label: Handoff Protocol
nodes.rationale: Mandatory handoff.md update after each request with estado atual, arquivos alterados, problemas, proximos passos

nodes.label: Development Commands
nodes.rationale: npm run dev/build/lint/typecheck/test/db:* for root, api, web, shared, database workspaces

nodes.label: Known Issues/Risks
nodes.rationale: Two Prisma schemas, CampaignLog relation, missing sendErrorNotification, TS errors, Docker build, Evolution unverified, no GitHub remote

nodes.label: Recommended Workflow
nodes.rationale: Git status -> Unify Prisma -> Compile order (shared->database->api->web) -> Docker build/up -> Test Evolution -> Push GitHub
